provenance: Generated locally by scripts/generate_packet_inspector_fixtures.py; all contents synthetic.

dns.pcap.purpose: Simple DNS request and response; example.test uses documentation addresses.

http-reassembled.pcap.purpose: HTTP GET split across frames 4 and 5 to exercise reassembly and uncertain source offsets.

nas-ngap.pcap.purpose: SCTP PPID 60 → NGAP InitialUEMessage → NAS-5GS; no decode-as rules needed.
nas-ngap.pcap.1: Plain registration request, initial registration+FOR+ngKSI 7, fake SUCI 001/01.
nas-ngap.pcap.2: Integrity-only outer header with clear Registration Complete, deliberately invalid dummy MAC deadbeef.
nas-ngap.pcap.3: Ciphered outer header with deterministic opaque payload; not real encryption and must not be presented as recovered plaintext.
nas-ngap.pcap.4: Integrity-protected new context Security Mode Command; NEA2+NIA2, deliberately invalid dummy MAC aabbccdd.
nas-ngap.pcap.warning: NAS bodies test decoding only; four InitialUEMessage envelopes do not form a valid live registration procedure or security context.

truncated.pcap.purpose: Snaplen-truncated NAS frame: original wire length exceeds stored bytes.
